name: Bolingbrook
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Bolingbrook, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Bolingbrook, IL: the Festival of Lights Winter Walk, a caroling campfire at Hidden Oaks, Breakfast with Santa and trains nearby.
lede: Bolingbrook celebrates Christmas around the pond behind its Town Center, where the Festival of Lights Winter Walk glows each December, and Santa leaves town in style at the end of the season.
celebrates: The Village of Bolingbrook's Special Events Commission hosts the Festival of Lights and the Santa Send Off, and it judges the Spirit of Christmas house decorating contest with an online map of entries. The Winter Walk lights line the path around the pond behind Town Center at 375 W. Briarcliff Road, and the Mistletoe Market adds holiday shopping on select nights. Nearby, the Forest Preserve District of Will County hosts a free caroling campfire at Hidden Oaks Nature Center, the Bolingbrook Golf Club serves Breakfast with Santa, and the Bolingbrook Park District offers holiday classes for little kids.
lastyear: In 2025 Patch reported that the Festival of Lights Winter Walk was planned for four December evenings at Bolingbrook Town Center, with the first Mistletoe Market, free Santa photos, a tree lighting with the 2025 Citizens of the Year and free train rides. Later that month Patch reported that weather canceled the final night of the market, which was moved to December 21, with ice sculpting, free Santa photos and entertainment by Dale Tippett Jr.
facts: WJOL reported in 2020 that the Winter Walk behind Town Center came back for the first time in many years, set along the path around the pond so visitors could spread out. That year the lights were best seen from dusk to 10 pm daily. For the 2023 Santa Send Off, Santa left Town Center at 3 pm, rode a route with stops across the village and was set to leave for the North Pole by helicopter from Clow International Airport.
trains: Metra's Romeoville station, at 899 E. Romeo Road in the neighboring village, is on the Heritage Corridor line. Metra's Holiday Trains, specially decorated trains with holiday characters, run in December on the BNSF, Milwaukee District North and Rock Island lines, so check Metra's holiday train page for the schedule. For a train ride with Santa, the Illinois Railway Museum in Union runs a holiday train each season, and the Fox River Trolley Museum in South Elgin runs Santa's Trolley Express.
train_links: The largest railway museum in the US, with holiday train rides each season.
Historic trolley rides along the Fox River in South Elgin, plus Santa's Trolley Express.
traditions: Lighted displays line the path around the pond behind Bolingbrook Town Center on Briarcliff Road.
Holiday vendors join the Winter Walk evenings, a market that made its debut in 2025.
Santa tours the village with stops at schools, parks and the library before flying away by helicopter.
The Special Events Commission judges decorated homes and shares an online map so families can drive past them.
Families sing carols, roast s'mores and hike by lantern light at Hidden Oaks Nature Center.
Bolingbrook Golf Club serves a full breakfast with Santa visits and photos, one of its most popular holiday traditions.
kidfact: Santa does not leave Bolingbrook by sleigh. At the 2023 Santa Send Off, he was set to fly to the North Pole by helicopter from Clow International Airport, right in the village.
faq: Where is the Bolingbrook Festival of Lights?

The Festival of Lights Winter Walk is set up along the path around the pond behind Bolingbrook Town Center, at 375 W. Briarcliff Road. The Village of Bolingbrook's Special Events Commission hosts it each December, and the Mistletoe Market and Santa photos have been part of the event nights. Check the village special events page for this season's nights and times before you go.
What is the Bolingbrook Santa Send Off?

The Santa Send Off is a village tradition hosted by the Special Events Commission at the end of the season. In 2023 Santa started at Town Center, made stops around Bolingbrook at places like the library, the BRAC and the golf club, and was set to leave by helicopter from Clow International Airport. Times are estimates, so families watch for updates on the day.
Is there a free Christmas event for kids in Bolingbrook?

Yes. The Forest Preserve District of Will County holds a free Caroling Campfire at Hidden Oaks Nature Center with carols, s'mores, a lantern lit hike and crafts, plus a free Holiday Nature Crafts day. Neither needs registration. Bass Pro Shops at The Promenade also offers a free photo with Santa when you reserve a time online.
Where can kids see Santa in Bolingbrook?

Families can book a free photo with Santa at Bass Pro Shops at The Promenade Bolingbrook, or reserve Breakfast with Santa at the Bolingbrook Golf Club, which includes a full breakfast and photos. Santa has also visited the Festival of Lights Winter Walk nights behind Town Center, where Patch reported free Santa photos in past years.
Where can I see Christmas lights in Bolingbrook?

Start at the Winter Walk around the pond behind Town Center. The village also runs the Spirit of Christmas contest, which judges decorated homes and posts an online map. In past years a village trustee shared a resident nominated guide of decorated houses that listed more than 65 homes and was updated every few days.
